heading: INT. GLASS-DOMED OBSERVATORY, LUNAR FAR SIDE STATION - DAY

units.text: INT. GLASS-DOMED OBSERVATORY, LUNAR FAR SIDE STATION - DAY
A great telescope sleeps under a sheet of dust.
Earthlight spills through the dome.
Six people sit around a folding table, plates of reconstituted eggs untouched.
COMMANDER HORATIO LINDQVIST (50s, silver temples, careful) presides.
DR. AMARA OKONKWO-REYES (40s, sharp, notebook) sits at his right.
TECHNICIAN BEN YAZZIE (30s) fiddles with a salt packet.
MRS. CORDELIA FAIRWEATHER (60s, tailored, a visitor from the supply ship) eats nothing.
ENGINEER JUNE KAWAMURA (30s) stirs her coffee.
A tall man in a station jacket, STRANGER (40s, unreadable), stands just inside the door, hat in hand.
Mrs. Fairweather, I trust you slept well.
units.name: COMMANDER LINDQVIST

units.text: Remarkably. I'm told the silence here is the best in the solar system.
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: It is. Nothing carries.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: Not even sound. Not even, y'know, gossip.
units.name: YAZZIE

units.text: Ben.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: What? I'm only saying.
units.name: YAZZIE

units.text: The Stranger takes a step forward.
Everyone turns, then politely turns back.
And who is our guest?
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: We haven't met, ma'am. I came in with the supply crew.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: He's the new relief mechanic. Name of Pryce. Mr. Pryce, sit down.
units.name: COMMANDER LINDQVIST

units.text: Thank you, Commander.
units.name: PRYCE

units.text: He takes the empty chair.
Okonkwo-Reyes studies him over her notebook.
Mr. Pryce, forgive me. The crew manifest for last Thursday's flight lists twelve passengers. Twelve names. None of them yours.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: I came on the second shuttle.
units.name: PRYCE

units.text: There was no second shuttle.
units.name: OKONKWO-REYES

units.text: Silence.
June's spoon stops.
Yazzie's salt packet bursts, scattering white on the table like frost.
Dr. Okonkwo-Reyes--
units.name: COMMANDER LINDQVIST

units.text: It's all right, Commander. She's right.
units.name: PRYCE

units.text: He rises.
Straightens his jacket.
Takes off the station badge and lays it on the table, face up.
My name is Pryce. I'm the chairman of the board that signed off on this station. I came to see for myself whether the stories were true.
units.name: PRYCE

units.text: What stories?
units.name: CORDELIA

units.text: That the telescope hasn't worked since March. That the funding was diverted. That everyone at this table has been lying to Earth for six months.
units.name: PRYCE

units.text: Nobody moves.
The earthlight, blue and enormous, slides a finger of shadow across the dome.
Mr. Pryce. Before you say another word, I'd ask you to look up.
units.name: COMMANDER LINDQVIST

units.text: Pryce looks up.
Through the dome, far off, a point of light blooms and pulses.
Then another.
Then a ring of them, pale as pearls, arranged in a perfect circle.
What am I looking at?
units.name: PRYCE

units.text: The reason we stopped reporting.
units.name: COMMANDER LINDQVIST
